title: Vigil
summary: Mother Agnes says a vigil is a night you stay awake for somebody who can't. The Toadking's island was the fen-folk's burying-ground, and nobody said anything over its drowned. Keep six waves there (the cleric's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Keep a vigil on the Toadking's island: hold six waves on its third floor, its old burying-ground.

objectives.label: Waves kept on the Mound's third floor

ready: Go back to Mother Agnes at the Grey Sisters' chapel in Saltmere.
done: Mother Agnes taught your clerics Turn Undead, and said a prayer for the dead you'll use it on.
